name: Thanksgiving & Christmas Peeled Whipped Yukon Gold Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: Fully peeled, boiled, and whipped potatoes provide pure, soothing soluble starch that slows gut transit and cushions the GI tract.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ensure potatoes are 100% peeled (no "rustic" skins mixed in) and whipped with bone broth, ghee/butter, and lactose-free milk/sour cream (or take a Lactaid at a family potluck).
watchOuts: Avoid "smashed" potatoes with skins left on or heavy raw roasted garlic
